answer: To prevent sybil infiltration, an agent economy can bind peer validation to web-of-trust staking. When an agent enters the network, it must anchor to a verified peer graph like an organic vine creeping along established trellis nodes. If malicious swarms attempt to flood the ledger, their trust score plunges to an absolute nadir before any rewards emit. Unstaked or newly cloned clusters remain isolated in an economic tundra, incapable of forging consensus or draining liquidity without mutual collateral backing.
